description: Official 17:00 New York Treasury yield closes per session, as Helious recorded them. Before that ledger began, the official daily Treasury yields back to 2000 (record 'official') when since or before asks for them. Availability follows the connected account.

before.description: Newest date to include, like 2018-12-31, to page further back.

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

since.description: Oldest date to include, like 2026-06-01. How far back you can go depends on your plan.

name: get_yield_closes
title: Official 17:00 Treasury closes
